title: Heaps and Priority Queues Challenge #1: Kth Largest Element
statement: Given an input configuration, implement an optimal algorithm to solve the Kth Largest Element problem for Heaps and Priority Queues. `solve(nums: list) -> int`.
explanation: Solves the problem using an optimal Kth Largest Element technique under Heaps and Priority Queues.
commonMistakes: Boundary indexing errors on empty or single-element inputs.
Unnecessary nested loops degrading complexity to O(N^2).
